t: Timba PZ double-countersunk decking screws are engineered for robust and efficient outdoor timber construction. These 4.0mm x 40mm carbon steel screws are ideal for professional landscapers and serious DIYers tackling decking, fencing, and other exterior timber projects. A double self-countersunk head provides a perfectly flush finish, while underhead ribs remove the need for time-consuming counterboring. The razor-sharp slash tip ensures an ultra-quick start with no pre-drilling required, cutting cleanly through wood. Featuring a durable green organic coating, these decking screws offer excellent corrosion resistance for long-lasting performance in all weather conditions.
b: 40° Thread for Secure Fixing & High Pull-Out Resistance
Underhead Ribs Eliminate Need For Counterboring
Suitable For All Decking & Outdoor Timber Projects
